process_arrangement: generator and SUT in one process; fresh process per cell; cells executed sequentially

capacity_derivation.rounding: round half up of capacity times factor

blocker.classification: measurement-harness and schedule incompatibility; not engine-bound
conditions: The open-loop scheduler rejects rates that do not divide 1e9. Ten of the eighteen frozen per-delay rates are therefore unexecutable, including frozen zero-delay rates 3000 and 6000 per second and the derived 5 ms 1.0x rate of 198 per second.
High-rate and concurrent batch cells produced fatal module_restarted, early EOF, and broken-pipe outcomes. These cells are invalid under the frozen gate.
Six treatment positions were invalid solely for missed scheduled slots; they were retained and not replaced.
The byte-identical A/A control had only 141 paired valid cells and a logical p95 ratio range of 0.757 to 77.815, so the required null schedule was not stable enough for selection.
Load average was not captured before each block, so the environment manifest is incomplete against the run-record contract.

queue_objective.zero_delay_1x: Baseline and K=1/K=2 all had zero terminal rejection and sub-0.1 ms p95 latency; objective did not distinguish K.
queue_objective.five_ms_1x: Not executable because 198/s does not divide 1e9 under the harness scheduler.
queue_objective.twenty_five_ms_1x: Baseline and K=1/K=2 all had zero terminal rejection. K=1 reduced p95 from 531.6-733.0 ms to 28.6-28.9 ms and amplification from 3.10-3.15 to 1.0, with p95 permit wait 3.5-3.9 ms. The strict lower-terminal-blocking objective was not met because baseline terminal blocking was already zero.

usl_gate: USL not applicable — two repetitions without confidence intervals; gate requires at least five repetitions with CIs
